Commitments that are unconditionally cancellable at any time by the bank without prior notice, or that effectively provide for automatic cancellation due to deterioration in a borrower’s creditworthiness (e.g. loan commitment) shall be applied CCF of 10% (=Sum of 1.1 up to 1.10)

Applies to both the issuing and confirming banks of short-term self-liquidating trade letters of credit arising from the movement of goods (e.g. documentary credits collateralized by the underlying shipment, letter of credit, except standby letter of credit) shall be applied CCF of 20% (=Sum of 2.1 up to 2.10)
Commitments, regardless of the maturity of the underlying facility, unless they qualify for a lower CCF, shall be applied CCF of 40% (=Sum of 3.1 up to 3.10)

Certain transaction-related contingent items including performance bonds, bid bonds, warranties and standby letters of credit related to particular transactions, shall be applied CCF of 50%. (=Sum of 4.1 up to 4.10)
Note issuance facilities (NIFs) and revolving underwriting facilities (RUFs) regardless of the maturity of the underlying facility, shall be applied CCF of 50 %. ( =Sum of 5.1 up to 5.10).

Direct credit substitutes, e.g. general guarantees of indebtedness (including standby letters of credit serving as financial guarantees for loans and securities) and acceptances (including endorsements with the character of acceptances), shall be applied CCF of 100% (=Sum of 6.1 up to 6.10).
Sale and repurchase agreements and asset sales with recourse where the credit risk remains with the bank, shall be applied CCF of 100% (=Sum of 7.1 up to 7.10)

Lending of banks’ securities or the posting of securities as collateral by banks, including instances where these arise out of repo-style transactions (i.e. repurchase/reverse repurchase and securities lending/securities borrowing transactions), shall be applied CCF of 100% (=Sum of 8.1 up to 8.10)

Forward asset purchases, forward deposits and partly paid shares and securities which represent commitments with certain drawdown and shall be weighted according to the type of asset and not accordingly to the type of counterparty with whom the transaction has been entered into, shall be applied CCF of 100% (=Sum of 9.1 up to 9.10).
Off-balance sheet items that are credit substitutes not explicitly included in any other category, shall be applied CCF of 100% (=Sum of 10.1 up to 10.10).
